stops.title: Di Dairɛktri
stops.caption: Ɔlman, pan wan lis.
stops.speech: Mɛmba na di dairɛktri. Ɔlman insay di chɔch de ya, wit dɛn om branch ɛn if dɛn dɔn du di mɛmbaship klas.

stops.title: Fɔ Fɛn Sɔmbɔdi
stops.caption: Wit nem, imel ɔ fon.
stops.speech: Rayt nem, imel ɔ fon nɔmba insay di sach bɔks. Yu kin filta bay branch, bay stetɔs, ɔ bay rol bak.

stops.title: Fɔ Opin Prɔfayl
stops.caption: Ɔl dɛn istri na wan ples.
stops.speech: If yu klik wan layn i de opin dat pɔsin: dɛn kɔntakt, dɛn grup, dɛn atɛndans ɛn ɛvri fɔlo ɔp bɔt dɛn.
